text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, the days of taking on the Twinkle Series
with Sakura Chiyono O begin!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Also, there is a joint orientation session
for the Umamusume making their debuts soon, but..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hawa, wawawa. F-F-F-Finally, this
day has come... Um, uuum...
choice_data_list: Want to take a deep breath or something?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes!
Please join me!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list: You can't just inhale, you have to exhale too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Whew!
Whew!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list: ...Are you all right, Chiyono O?
...Are you okay, Chiyono O?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine!
Probably. Most definitely! Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, I stepped into the classroom
for the information session alongside
a stiff-as-a-board Sakura Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, ooh... What an aura...!
Your aura is, like, incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My, Chiyono O.
Please, this seat here is open.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ardan-san!
I look forward to racing with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one speaking to her now is Mejiro Ardan,
a young lady of the Mejiro family. She's in a higher
grade, but... it seems they'll debut in the same year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In other words, despite being in different school years, all the Umamusume gathered here become Sakura Chiyono O's classmates.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking around once more, there's quite a crowd.
On top of that, there seem to be some girls
transferring in off-season as well...
choice_data_list: (...There are a lot of potential rivals to keep in mind.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Assuming Sakura Chiyono O's mind was completely blank from nerves,
she was trying her best to memorize the rivals' characteristics—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, Sakura Chiyono O poked me in the ribs
and handed me "something."
choice_data_list: What is this...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um, these are the notes I prepared in advance.
I just thought, you know, they might be of
some help to you, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the notepad she handed me,
I found it densely covered with handwritten notes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You can keep the memo, Trainer!
I've already memorized everything written on it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: For example, page one!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo-san is a hot-blooded Disciplinary Committee head.
True to her spirited nature, she specializes in sprints
and miles that are decided in short order.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
However, due to her weak hooves,
she reportedly chose to debut on dirt rather than turf.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "Conversely, Creek-san is a stayer type who specializes in long distances. What's especially noteworthy is that she's also amazing at 'taking care' of others."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
In other words, she has a good eye for people.
Which means she can see right through your strengths and weaknesses.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And that concludes the Chiyo Investigation Report!
I've prepared pages for Ardan-san
and Yaeno-san in the second half!
choice_data_list: You've really done your research, huh...!
You've really done your research, haven't you...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehe... Ehehe. Preparation and review
are the basics of basics, after all...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Besides, we have to work hard
if we want to win the Nippon Derby.
choice_data_list: The "Japan Derby", huh?
The "Japan Derby"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For Sakura Chiyono O, that was a crucial race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O has an Umamusume
she looks up to: "Maruzensky."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O had been entrusted with a dream by that Umamusume, who boasted overwhelming strength and was hailed as a "Monster."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...Give it your all in the real Japanese Derby too, okay?
I'm entrusting my feelings to you!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Maruzen-san's feelings, her hopes...
............entrusted to me?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Without fail... I swear!
I will win the Japanese Derby!
I will prove that I'm the strongest Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "So, when that happens...! Would you... run with the stronger me again...?!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“...You can only challenge the Japanese Derby once in your lifetime.
And only one person can claim victory there.”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I will.
For her sake too—
choice_data_list: We'll win the Derby, no matter what, alright?
We'll win the Derby, no matter what, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And after the joint information session ended,
since we had the time, we decided to begin
a shortened training session."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Trainer-san.
Can we... have a water break, please...!
choice_data_list: Yeah, no problem at all.
Yeah, I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While she rests, I look over the notepad I received earlier.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Especially when aiming for the Derby,
the ones who seem likely to be rivals are—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First would be Yaeno Muteki.
I hear she's also skilled at middle distance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: According to the note, she's a disciple of the Kongo Yaegaki style and the granddaughter of the grandmaster. As expected of someone trained in martial arts, her burst of speed is said to be astonishing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Also, Mejiro Ardan, whom Sakura Chiyono O was just talking to,
might enter the Derby as well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is the younger sister of the Mejiro family's treasure, Mejiro Ramonu, who achieved the first-ever Triple Tiara.
Her raw talent and the expectations placed upon her are exceedingly high.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If she doesn't choose the Tiara route...
she'll likely be a formidable rival for Sakura Chiyono O
in the Japanese Derby."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Puhaaah... Energy recharged!
Trainer, let's do another—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah!?
choice_data_list: Wah!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O suddenly froze, staring at a single spot.
Following her gaze...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing there were Maruzensky and the
"Triple Crown Umamusume," Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Still, it's rare to see Maruzensky hanging around near the track. I heard she was holding off on running in the Twinkle Series for a while, though...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Chiyo-chaaaan! Do your best~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah... whoa, whoaaa!
Y-Yeeeeeesss!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehe. Ehehe... What should I do?
Maruzen-san told me to do my best...
choice_data_list: You're being all lovey-dovey, huh.
You're being all lovey-dovey, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: B-Because it's my dream!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A shocking and dazzling "Supercar"
that seemed poised to shatter every conventional mold.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
When I saw that person run, I thought to myself:
I want to become like Maruzen-san too,
and stand side by side with her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No matter how mediocre an Umamusume I might be, that dream is the one thing I refuse to give up...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...It's far too lofty a dream,
so it might be out of my reach, but...
choice_data_list: Then I'll be your stepping stone.
Then I'll be your pedestal.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: If you get on top of that, maybe you can reach your dream

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Heh... hehehe.
I couldn't possibly be so disrespectful
as to use you as a stepping stone, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"However, hearing those words
just gave me an idea for a maxim!"
choice_data_list: What kind of saying?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: We're going to be working as a three-legged race from now on, right? So...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Like "Chiyo's the pot, and Trainer's the ladle"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The pot and the ladle each have different roles, but to make a delicious chanko stew, you need them both together!
choice_data_list: "Chiyo is the pot, and Trainer is the ladle," huh...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Yes!
I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so began the days
of training with Sakura Chiyono O.
